desc: Implement iterative root/postorder and adjacency list.
Define DP arrays for parent-edge present/absent and has-degree-4 flag with impossible sentinel.
For each vertex in postorder, combine children via small DP over selected child count 0..4 and degree-4 flag.
Convert knapsack results to vertex DP values: parent-present allows 0 or 3 child edges; parent-absent allows 1 or 4 child edges; set flag true when resulting degree is 4.
Compute maximum parent-absent DP value with flag true across all vertices; print it or -1.
Verify against samples and edge cases (N<5, high degree, recursion avoidance).
